about_the_game:
**Breaking Point: Operation Exodus** is an exciting sci-fi shooter that offers a comprehensive experience with:

**Single-player Campaign:** Explore an engaging narrative as you face an alien invasion. Each mission will take you through unique landscapes, from devastated cities to hidden space bases.

**Dynamic Combat:** Utilize a wide variety of weapons and abilities to confront waves of alien enemies. Adjust your strategy to survive each encounter, ranging from close-quarters combat to intense long-range shootouts.

**Exploration and Discovery:** Uncover secret areas and collectibles that reveal the hidden story of the conflict. Every corner may hold secrets that enrich the narrative.

**Character Progression:** Upgrade your skills and unlock new weapons as you progress through the game, adapting to ever-increasing challenges.

**Immersive Graphics and Sound:** Immerse yourself in detailed intergalactic environments, with music and sound effects designed to amplify the action and excitement.

Includes all levels, weapons, and content ready to play from launch. Fight for the survival of humanity in an epic intergalactic conflict. Are you ready to face the challenge?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3570K / AMD FX-8310
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 780 / AMD Radeon RX 470
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: It is recommended to have the GPU drivers updated.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700K / AMD Ryzen 5 2600X
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 / AMD Radeon RX Vega 56
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: It is recommended to have the GPU drivers updated.

short_description: It’s an exciting first-person shooting game where you lead an elite squad against a devastating alien invasion. Defend iconic cities, infiltrate secret bases, and discover hidden secrets. With stunning graphics, fight for the survival of humanity.
supported_languages:
English*, French*, Italian*, German*, Simplified Chinese*, Korean*, Spanish - Latin America*, Indonesian*, Japanese*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Russian*
*languages with full audio support
